description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractErrorRenderer' in the 'Slimror' namespace, which implements error rendering logic for the Slim Framework, handling error titles and descriptions depending on exception types.

classes.name: AbstractErrorRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for error renderers in the Slim framework, handling error message formatting based on exceptions.

methods.name: getErrorTitle
methods.description: Returns the error title based on the exception. Uses the exception's getTitle method if it's an HttpException, otherwise returns the default error title.

methods.name: getErrorDescription
methods.description: Returns the error description based on the exception. Uses the exception's getDescription method if it's an HttpException, otherwise returns the default error description.
